titulo.estudio: しえき と しえきうけみ

intro: Look at the pattern in short examples and check what information it gives in context.

palabras.significado: were made to play (passive form of ひく)

piezas.titulo: The causative can express that someone makes another person do something or allows them to do it; the causative passive usually presents an action imposed on the subject.
texto: In group 1, u → a + せる; group 2, る → させる; する → させる; 来る → 来させる. In the causative passive: せられる or させられる. Don't always translate the causative as "force"; context decides between permission and obligation.
せんせい は がくせい に ほん を よませました。 (The teacher made the students read a book (or let them read it).)
わたし は こども の ころ、 まいにち ピアノ を ひかされました。 (As a child, I was made to play the piano every day.)
